newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: TENNIS-BOETSCH KNOCKS OUT THIRD-SEEDED KAFELNIKOV.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BOETSCH KNOCKS OUT THIRD-SEEDED KAFELNIKOV.

text.p: Frenchman Arnaud Boetsch ended Yevgeny Kafelnikov's pursuit of his fifth title of the year when he beat the third-seeded Russian 7-6 7-6 in the quarterfinals of the CA Trophy on Friday.
Unseeded Boetsch won both sets of a tight but bland match on the indoor hardcourts in tiebreaks, the first by 7-5 and the second 7-2.
Boetsch's win reversed last week's result when he was beaten by the world number four in the final at Lyon.
Both players held serve throughout the first set but the pair exchanged service games twice in the second.
French Open champion Kafelnikov is the fifth seed to be knocked out of the tournament.
